geographyNote: Town of Lakeshore, Essex County, Ontario (census subdivision); not the Windsor CMA

facts.text: Lakeshore has a heavy concentration of auto-related supply plants and tool and mould shops.
facts.evidence: As for major industry and employers, Lakeshore has a heavy concentration of auto related supply plants and tool and mold shops, as well as a labour force for similar industry in Windsor and region.

facts.text: Lakeshore has a diversified economy with thriving sectors in advanced manufacturing, agribusiness and renewable energy.
facts.evidence: the municipality boasts a diversified economy, with thriving sectors in advanced manufacturing, agribusiness and renewable energy.

facts.text: Lakeshore is the largest and most populous municipality in Essex County.
facts.evidence: it is the largest and the most populous municipality within Essex County.

facts.text: Lakeshore has over 35 kilometres of waterfront on Lake St. Clair and is about 20 km east of Windsor.
facts.evidence: Lakeshore is located 20 km east of Windsor at the mouth of the Belle River on Lake St. Clair. Lakeshore's affordable lakefront community enjoys over 35 kilometres of waterfront

facts.text: Lakeshore added over 1,000 new homes and nearly 4,000 new residents between 2016 and 2021.
facts.evidence: The Census results showed nearly 4,000 new residents calling Lakeshore home since 2016. In the same period, the Municipality added over 1,000 new homes.

meta.descriptor: a lakefront town on Lake St. Clair, east of Windsor in Essex County
meta.fact: the largest and most populous municipality in Essex County

overview: Lakeshore had 40,410 residents in 2021, up 10.4% from 2016, in 14,386 occupied private dwellings spread across 529 square kilometres along Lake St. Clair. That mix of lakefront villages and farmland means customers are scattered, and many commute toward Windsor for work and shopping.

Auto parts plants and tool and mould shops anchor local employment. A business here competes both with neighbours in Belle River or Emeryville and with larger Windsor firms that are only a short drive away.
